messages:
Priya (AE): Hey team — Auriga procurement wants a completed SIG (v3) Q&A + supporting artifacts by EOD Fri. They flagged encryption, KMS, and vendor isolation as blockers.
Ethan (Security): OK. Do we have the list of SIG question IDs they expect answered, or are they asking for the full questionnaire?
Priya (AE): Full SIG. They said updated answers + artifacts for ENCR, ACCESS, and INFRA control families are must-haves. I'll attach their questionnaire PDF after this thread.
Lena (Solutions): I can map answers to existing docs. ETA tomorrow noon. Which artifacts are considered "must include"? SOC2, KMS policy, network diagram?
Ethan (Security): Minimal set: SOC2 report (redacted), KMS key rotation policy, config showing encryption-at-rest (db + storage), dataflow/DB schema note (what PII is stored), SSO/SCIM config, network/subnet diagram for private deployments, and a recent pen-test summary + dates.
Priya (AE): Auriga also asked about on-prem/offline options and customer-managed keys (HSM). They want proof we can rotate keys without downtime.
Ethan (Security): For key rotation we can include ops runbook excerpt and a short command example. I'll draft the snippet.
Ethan (Security): ```
# rotate key (example)
aws kms schedule-key-rotation --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789:key/abcd-ef01
# update app to use new key id via config rollout
kubectl set env deployment/redwood-inference REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=new-key-id
```
Lena (Solutions): I'll include that runbook excerpt and record a 90s demo clip of the rotation UI. :thumbsup:
cora (Legal): We'll need to redact any customer tenant IDs, IPs, or internal hostnames before sending. Use secure-share (S3 presigned with limited TTL).
evidence-bot: Uploaded files: soc2_redacted_2024.pdf, kms_policy_v2.pdf, pen_test_summary_q1_2025.pdf, network_diagram_private_vpc.png
Ethan (Security): Files received. Quick Q on SIG Q 3.2.1 (encryption key ownership): recommended answer: "We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations; reach out to SRE for onboarding and key rotation procedures." Shall I put that verbatim?
Priya (AE): Yes, keep it tight and factual. No roadmaps or future promises.
Lena (Solutions): Draft answers prepared and attached: auriga_sig_answers_v1.docx (maps question IDs -> artifact filenames). I flagged a few questions that need Legal wording.
Priya (AE): Thanks — I'll review. Also note Auriga requires a signed DPA before we hand over the full SOC2 report. cora, can you prepare?
cora (Legal): On it. I'll draft DPA and include standard redaction guidance.
Priya (AE): Final ask before I submit: confirm we support EU-only data residency (Auriga is EU-only).
Ethan (Security): Confirmed — EU-only data residency supported via Private deployment or Dedicated capacity with region pinning. I'll add a screenshot of the region selector and this statement: "We support EU-only data residency when configured via Private deployment or Dedicated, with contractually enforceable controls."
Priya (AE): Perfect. Plan: Lena/Ethan finalize artifacts + answers by tomorrow noon, Legal prepares DPA, I deliver to Auriga procurement after review. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Lena (Solutions): Will update the mapping doc with final filenames and upload a single zip for secure-share. :rocket:
